name: Parametric Marquee
author: Support Informatics

sections.description:
Parametric Marquee is a lightweight and powerful WordPress plugin that allows you to create a beautiful, smooth scrolling ticker ribbon anywhere on your website. Perfect for store announcements, flash sales, breaking news, or key highlights.

Features

  • Unlimited marquee text items with custom links.
  • Built-in Font Awesome icon selector for each item.
  • Drag & Drop reordering of items.
  • Full control over scroll speed, direction (left/right), gap, and font size.
  • Pause on hover functionality.
  • Seamless integration with Astra Theme Global Colors or custom hex colors.
  • Auto-display option right below the header or manual placement via shortcode.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to “Marquee Ribbon” in your admin menu to configure your settings.
  4. (Optional) Use the [parametric_marquee] shortcode in any page or widget.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release. Smooth layout with drag-and-drop support and Astra compatibility.
